repo.description: The `key` of the dev.knotless.repo that published the release, which also begins this record's key.

main.description: Kept in the repository owner's account, keyed as the release it withdraws is. Deleting it takes the yank back.

description: That the owner of a repository withdrew a version of a package it publishes: the dev.knotless.release of the same key in the same account, which itself never changes, stays there to read, but is no longer its package's latest.
